question.text: Pre-order checks by the broker system include:

answer.text: Price range check, Quantity freeze, Single order quantity/value limit, and UCC/PAN check

explanation.text: The Logic: Pre-order checks include: price range check, quantity freeze, single order quantity/value limit, user order value limits, cumulative open order value checks, and UCC/PAN verification. The Trap: Multiple risk-management checks are performed before an order reaches the exchange, not just one. Note: These order-entry and risk-management checks are designed to prevent erroneous orders from reaching the exchange.
